It uses only the\nRuby standard library plus SQLite, keeps domain logic in named modules under\n`lib/`, and implements a tiny TCP/HTTP layer under `lib/http/`.\n\n## Quick start\n\n```bash\nPORT=3000 ./run.sh\n```\n\n`run.sh` is a one-line wrapper that executes `ruby server.rb`. The server\nbinds to `127.0.0.1` and reads the port from the `PORT` environment variable\n(defaulting to `3000`).\n\nVerify it is listening:\n\n```bash\ncurl http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/health\n# => {\"ok\":true}\n```\n\nThe server runs in the foreground; stop it with `Ctrl-C` or by sending\n`SIGTERM` to the process.\n\n## Entry point and file layout\n\n- `run.sh` — the launcher required by the harness.\n- `server.rb` — the entry point. Requires standard-library gems and all\n  domain/HTTP modules in dependency order, then starts `HttpServer`.\n- `lib/config.rb` — runtime constants (`HOST`, `PORT`, `DB_PATH`,\n  `SCHEMA_VERSION`).\n- `lib/persistence.rb` — SQLite schema, connection wrapper, table lists, and\n  lifecycle helpers (`reset!`, `soft_reset!`, `initialize_schema!`).\n- `lib/pure_rules.rb` — deterministic, side-effect-free game-rule helpers.\n- `lib/auth.rb` — PBKDF2 password hashing and user/token storage.\n- `lib/combat.rb` — combat sessions, initiative, and turn/condition tracking.\n- `lib/compendium.rb` — monster and item reference entries.\n- `lib/campaigns.rb` — campaign metadata, characters, and event logs.\n- `lib/quests.rb` — campaign quest tracking and progress.\n- `lib/factions.rb` — campaign factions, NPCs, and relationship summaries.\n- `lib/inventory.rb` — campaign inventory and character equipment\n  assignments.\n- `lib/crafting.rb` — downtime crafting projects and progress.\n- `lib/sessions.rb` — campaign session scheduling and attendance.\n- `lib/analytics.rb` — campaign readiness and risk reports.\n- `lib/play_campaigns.rb` — protected campaign-play surface: ownership,\n  membership, turn queue, narration, actions, resolutions, documents,\n  locations, scenes, encounters, character builds, and combat.\n- `lib/player_handbook.rb` — PHB rule helpers (spell slots, rests,\n  encumbrance).\n- `lib/dm_tools.rb` — DM-facing helpers (encounter builder, loot parcel,\n  session recap).\n- `lib/http/request.rb` — HTTP request parsing.\n- `lib/http/response.rb` — HTTP response building.\n- `lib/http/router.rb` — method/path dispatch and JSON serialization.\n- `lib/http/http_server.rb` — TCP accept loop and keep-alive handling.\n\n## State, persistence, and routing\n\n### Persistence design\n\n- SQLite file: `game.db` in the working directory.\n- A single `Mutex` (`Persistence::DB_MUTEX`) serializes all database access.\n- `Persistence.db` yields a single shared `SQLite3::Database` connection that\n  is opened when the module loads and reused for the lifetime of the process.\n  This keeps the implementation simple and deterministic.\n- `Persistence::APP_TABLES` lists every application table in dependency\n  order. `reset!` and `soft_reset!` derive their drop lists from it, so adding\n  a table only requires one list update.\n- On startup the server calls `Persistence.reset!`. The schema statements use\n  `IF NOT EXISTS`, and `reset!` drops every application table (including\n  `users`) before recreating them, so the server begins each run with a clean\n  state.\n- `Persistence.soft_reset!` drops every application table *except* `users`\n  and `schema_meta`, then recreates the schema. It is used by the\n  `/v1/storage/reset` endpoint so authentication remains usable after a reset.\n- `Persistence.initialize_schema!` can be used to create missing tables without\n  dropping existing data.\n\n### Request routing\n\n- Raw socket I/O: `TCPServer` accepts connections; each connection is handled\n  in its own thread so the accept loop is never blocked. `Request.parse`\n  reads a request line, headers, and optional body.\n- `Router.route` is a long `if/elsif` dispatch that matches `method + path`.\n  Path parameters are captured with anchored regexes and forced to UTF-8 so\n  SQLite binds them as text rather than blobs.\n- Connections are kept open until the client closes them, supporting HTTP/1.1\n  keep-alive without pipelining issues.\n- Domain modules return `[:tag, data]` tuples:\n  - `:ok` with a Hash body,\n  - `:invalid` for validation failures,\n  - `:not_found` for missing resources,\n  - `:conflict` for duplicate IDs or business-rule conflicts,\n  - `:forbidden` for authorization failures.\n- `Router.handle_result` maps those tags to HTTP status codes (`200`, `201`,\n  `400`, `403`, `404`, `409`) and serializes the body as JSON.\n- Authenticated routes use `Router.with_auth` to centralize bearer-token\n  validation and role checks, returning `401` or `403` when appropriate.\n- Authentication endpoints (`/v1/auth/*`) are handled specially in the router\n  because `Auth` returns booleans rather than tuples. A successful login\n  returns a deterministic `session-<username>` token.\n\n## Main API/domain groupings\n\n| Group | Endpoints | Module |\n|-------|-----------|--------|\n| Core | `GET /health`, Conventions for extending and testing\n\n### Adding a new endpoint\n\n1. If the endpoint is pure computation, put it in the appropriate domain\n   module (e.g., `PureRules`, `PlayerHandbook`, `DmTools`) and have it return\n   a Hash on success or `nil` on invalid input.\n2. If the endpoint needs persistence, add it to the module that owns the data\n   (e.g., `Combat`, `Campaigns`, `Compendium`, `PlayCampaigns`) and return a\n   `[:tag, data]` tuple.\n3. Wire the endpoint into `Router.route` with an explicit `method`/`path`\n   check and call `handle_result` or `json_response` / `error_response` as\n   needed.\n4. If the endpoint requires authentication, wrap the handler with\n   `with_auth(request, %w[role]) { |actor| ... }`.\n5. If the endpoint creates a resource, use status `201`; otherwise use `200`.\n\n### Adding a new table\n\n1. Add the `CREATE TABLE` statement to `Persistence::SCHEMA_SQL`.\n2. Add the table name to `Persistence::APP_TABLES` in dependency order.\n   `reset!` and `soft_reset!` derive their drop lists from this single source.\n3. Add a module that owns reads and writes for that table.\n4. Keep validation logic private with `private_class_method`.\n\n### Shared helpers inside `PlayCampaigns`\n\n`PlayCampaigns` uses a few private helpers to keep repetition low:\n\n- `record_narration(d, campaign_id, kind, actor_name, text)` allocates the\n  next sequence number and inserts a narration row. All narration-producing\n  endpoints flow through it so sequence numbers stay monotonic.\n- `recent_events(d, campaign_id)` returns the newest narrations.\n- `build_encounter_order(...)` constructs or reuses the encounter turn order,\n  sorting by initiative with deterministic tie-breaking.\n- `public_combatant` / `public_order` strip internal `_` prefixed routing\n  keys before sending combatants to the client.\n\n### Testing locally\n\nBecause the server is a single entry point, you can run it directly:\n\n```bash\nPORT=3000 ruby server.rb\n```\n\nThen exercise endpoints with `curl` or any HTTP client. To reset state between\nmanual test runs, use:\n\n```bash\ncurl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/v1/storage/reset\n```\n\nFor automated regression testing, run the cumulative `dndeval` suite against\nthe running server. The cumulative suite exercises every endpoint above and\nverifies prior-stage behavior.\n\nYou can also load the codebase without starting the server to exercise domain\nmodules in isolation:\n\n```bash\nruby -Ilib -e \"load './server.rb'; puts Router.route(Request.new('GET', '/health', {}, nil)).to_s\"\n```\n\n### Determinism\n\n- Game-rule helpers are pure functions of their inputs.\n- Combat initiative uses deterministic tie-breaking (`score`, then `dex`, then\n  name for the legacy combat helper; `initiative`, then `name`, then `kind`,\n  then `_target` for encounter order in `PlayCampaigns`).\n- `DmTools.loot_parcel` is deterministic for a given tier and seed; it does\n  not use `SecureRandom`.\n- Password hashing still uses `SecureRandom` for salts, which is correct for\n  security and does not affect the deterministic test flows that register and\n  then immediately authenticate the same user.\n\n### What to avoid\n\n- Do not introduce Rack, Rails, Sinatra, or external gems. ORDER BY username',\n        campaign_id\n      ).map do |username, character_id, name, klass|\n        { 'username' => username, 'character_id' => character_id, 'name' => name, 'class' => klass }\n      end\n\n      recent_events = self.recent_events(d, campaign_id)\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'campaign_id' => campaign_id,\n        'needs_attention' => current_actor == owner,\n        'current_actor' => current_actor,\n        'party' => members,\n        'recent_events' => recent_events\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.submit_action(campaign_id, actor, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    type = payload['type']\n    text = payload['text']\n    return [:invalid] unless type.is_a?(String) && !type.empty? &&\n                             text.is_a?(String) && !text.empty?\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign = d.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT owner, current_actor FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?',\n        campaign_id\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign\n\n      owner, current_actor = campaign\n      next [:conflict] if owner == actor[:username]\n\n      is_member = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT 1 FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? WHERE id = ?',\n        [owner, campaign_id]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'sequence' => next_sequence,\n        'kind' => 'action',\n        'actor' => actor[:username],\n        'type' => type,\n        'text' => text,\n        'next_actor' => 'dm'\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.resolve(campaign_id, actor, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    text = payload['text']\n    return [:invalid] unless text.is_a?(String) && !text.empty?\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign = d.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT owner, current_actor, turn_number FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?',\n        campaign_id\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign\n\n      owner, current_actor, turn_number = campaign\n      next [:conflict] unless owner == actor[:username]\n      next [:conflict] unless current_actor == owner\n\n      members = d.execute(\n        'SELECT username FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? ORDER BY username',\n        campaign_id\n      ).map { |row| row[0] }\n\n      next [:conflict] if members.empty?\n\n      # The DM resolves a turn by advancing to the player who follows the one that\n      # submitted the most recent player-side turn (action or travel). Rest turns\n      # do not rotate the queue so a resting player keeps their place in the cycle.\n      last_action_row = d.get_first_row(\n        \"SELECT actor FROM play_narrations WHERE campaign_id = ? AND kind IN ('action', 'travel') ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1\",\n        campaign_id\n      )\n      last_actor = last_action_row ? last_action_row[0] : nil\n\n      next_actor = if last_actor && members.include?(last_actor)\n                     members[(members.index(last_actor) + 1) % members.length]\n                   else\n                     members[0]\n                   end\n\n      next_sequence = record_narration(d, campaign_id, 'resolution', 'dm', text)\n\n      new_turn_number = turn_number.to_i + 1\n\n      d.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaigns SET current_actor = ?, turn_number = ? WHERE id = ?',\n        [next_actor, new_turn_number, campaign_id]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'sequence' => next_sequence,\n        'kind' => 'resolution',\n        'actor' => 'dm',\n        'text' => text,\n        'next_actor' => next_actor,\n        'turn_number' => new_turn_number\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.nudge(campaign_id, actor, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    message = payload['message']\n    return [:invalid] unless message.is_a?(String) && !message.empty?\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign = d.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT owner, status, current_actor, nudge_count FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?',\n        campaign_id\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign\n\n      owner, status, current_actor, nudge_count = campaign\n      next [:forbidden] unless owner == actor[:username]\n      next [:conflict] unless status == 'active' && current_actor\n\n      new_nudge_count = nudge_count.to_i + 1\n      d.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaigns SET nudge_count = ? WHERE id = ?',\n        [new_nudge_count, campaign_id]\n      )\n\n      next_sequence = record_narration(d, campaign_id, 'nudge', owner, message)\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'actor' => owner,\n        'target' => current_actor,\n        'message' => message,\n        'nudge_count' => new_nudge_count\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.get_document(campaign_id, actor)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign = d.get_first_row('SELECT owner FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign\n\n      owner = campaign[0]\n      is_member = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT 1 FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?',\n        [campaign_id, actor[:username]]\n      )\n\n      if owner == actor[:username]\n        row = d.get_first_row(\n          'SELECT story, dm_notes FROM play_campaign_documents WHERE campaign_id = ?',\n          campaign_id\n        )\n        story = row ? row[0] : ''\n        dm_notes = row ? row[1] : ''\n        [:ok, { 'story' => story, 'dm_notes' => dm_notes }]\n      elsif is_member\n        row = d.get_first_row(\n          'SELECT story FROM play_campaign_documents WHERE campaign_id = ?',\n          campaign_id\n        )\n        story = row ? row[0] : ''\n        [:ok, { 'story' => story }]\n      else\n        [:forbidden]\n      end\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.update_document(campaign_id, actor, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    story = payload['story']\n    dm_notes = payload['dm_notes']\n    return [:invalid] unless story.is_a?(String) && dm_notes.is_a?(String)\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign = d.get_first_row('SELECT owner FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign\n\n      owner = campaign[0]\n      next [:forbidden] unless owner == actor[:username]\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO play_campaign_documents (campaign_id, story, dm_notes) VALUES (?, ?, ?)\n         ON CONFLICT(campaign_id) DO UPDATE SET story = excluded.story, dm_notes = excluded.dm_notes',\n        [campaign_id, story, dm_notes]\n      )\n\n      next_sequence = record_narration(d, campaign_id, 'document', owner, story)\n\n      [:ok, { 'story' => story, 'dm_notes' => dm_notes }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.create_scene(campaign_id, actor, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    data = validate_scene(payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless data\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign = d.get_first_row('SELECT owner FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign\n      next [:forbidden] unless campaign[0] == actor[:username]\n\n      existing = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT 1 FROM play_campaign_scenes WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?',\n        [campaign_id, actor[:username]]\n      )\n      next [:forbidden] unless member\n\n      next [:conflict] unless current_actor == actor[:username]\n\n      hp_current = member[2]\n      hp_max = member[3]\n      new_hp_current = type == 'long' ? hp_max : hp_current\n\n      if type == 'long'\n        d.execute(\n          'UPDATE play_campaign_members SET hp_current = ?, status = ?, death_save_successes = ?, death_save_failures = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?',\n          [hp_max, 'conscious', 0, 0, campaign_id, actor[:username]]\n        )\n      end\n\n      next_sequence = record_narration(d, campaign_id, 'rest', actor[:username], \"took a #{type} rest\")\n\n      d.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaigns SET current_actor = ? WHERE id = ?',\n        [owner, campaign_id]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'sequence' => next_sequence,\n        'kind' => 'rest',\n        'actor' => actor[:username],\n        'type' => type,\n        'hp_current' => new_hp_current,\n        'hp_max' => hp_max,\n        'next_actor' => 'dm'\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.validate_connection(payload)\n    return nil unless payload.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    to_id = payload['to_id']\n    travel_turns = payload['travel_turns']\n\n    return nil unless to_id.is_a?(String) && !to_id.empty? WHERE id = ?\",\n        [first_actor, 1, campaign_id]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'id' => campaign_id,\n        'status' => 'active',\n        'current_actor' => first_actor,\n        'turn_number' => 1\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.narrate(campaign_id, actor, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    text = payload['text']\n    return [:invalid] unless text.is_a?(String) && !text.empty?\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign = d.get_first_row('SELECT owner FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign\n\n      owner = campaign[0]\n      next [:forbidden] unless owner == actor[:username]\n\n      next_sequence = record_narration(d, campaign_id, 'narration', 'dm', text)\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'sequence' => next_sequence,\n        'kind' => 'narration',\n        'actor' => 'dm',\n        'text' => text\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.turn(campaign_id, actor)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign = d.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT owner, status, current_actor, turn_number FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?',\n        campaign_id\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign\n\n      owner, status, current_actor, turn_number = campaign\n      is_member = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT 1 FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?',\n        [campaign_id, actor[:username]]\n      )\n      next [:forbidden] unless owner == actor[:username] || is_member\n\n      phase = current_actor == owner ? 'dm' : 'player'\n\n      # The queue visualizes the full turn cycle: each player followed by a DM turn.\n      # The actual current actor is driven by `current_actor`, not by advancing this queue.\n      members = d.execute(\n        'SELECT username FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? ORDER BY username',\n        campaign_id\n      ).map { |row| row[0] }\n      queue = members.flat_map { |m| [m, 'dm'] }\n\n      deadline = turn_number.is_a?(Integer) ? turn_number + 1 : nil\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'campaign_id' => campaign_id,\n        'current_actor' => current_actor,\n        'phase' => phase,\n        'turn_number' => turn_number,\n        'queue' => queue,\n        'overdue' => false,\n        'logical_deadline' => deadline\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.my_turn(campaign_id, actor)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign = d.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT current_actor FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?',\n        campaign_id\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign\n\n      member = d.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT character_id, name FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?',\n        [campaign_id, actor[:username]]\n      )\n      next [:forbidden] unless member\n\n      character_id, name = member\n      current_actor = campaign[0]\n\n      recent_events = self.recent_events(d, campaign_id)\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'is_my_turn' => current_actor == actor[:username],\n        'current_actor' => current_actor,\n        'character' => { 'id' => character_id, 'name' => name },\n        'recent_events' => recent_events\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.gm_status(campaign_id, actor)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign = d.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT owner, current_actor FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?',\n        campaign_id\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign\n\n      owner, current_actor = campaign\n      next [:forbidden] unless owner == actor[:username]\n\n      members = d.execute(\n        'SELECT username, character_id, name, class FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? ORDER BY username',\n        campaign_id\n      ).map do |username, character_id, name, klass|\n        { 'username' => username, 'character_id' => character_id, 'name' => name, 'class' => klass }\n      end\n\n      recent_events = self.recent_events(d, campaign_id)\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'campaign_id' => campaign_id,\n        'needs_attention' => current_actor == owner,\n        'current_actor' => current_actor,\n        'party' => members,\n        'recent_events' => recent_events\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.submit_action(campaign_id, actor, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    type = payload['type']\n    text = payload['text']\n    return [:invalid] unless type.is_a?(String) && !type.empty? &&\n                             text.is_a?(String) && !text.empty?\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign = d.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT owner, current_actor FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?',\n        campaign_id\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign\n\n      owner, current_actor = campaign\n      next [:conflict] if owner == actor[:username]\n\n      is_member = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT 1 FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?',\n        [campaign_id, actor[:username]]\n      )\n      next [:forbidden] unless is_member\n\n      next [:conflict] unless current_actor == actor[:username]\n\n      next_sequence = record_narration(d, campaign_id, 'action', actor[:username], text)\n\n      d.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaigns SET current_actor = ? WHERE id = ?',\n        [owner, campaign_id]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'sequence' => next_sequence,\n        'kind' => 'action',\n        'actor' => actor[:username],\n        'type' => type,\n        'text' => text,\n        'next_actor' => 'dm'\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.resolve(campaign_id, actor, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    text = payload['text']\n    return [:invalid] unless text.is_a?(String) && !text.empty?\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign = d.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT owner, current_actor, turn_number FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?',\n        campaign_id\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign\n\n      owner, current_actor, turn_number = campaign\n      next [:conflict] unless owner == actor[:username]\n      next [:conflict] unless current_actor == owner\n\n      members = d.execute(\n        'SELECT username FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? ORDER BY username',\n        campaign_id\n      ).map { |row| row[0] }\n\n      next [:conflict] if members.empty?\n\n      # The DM resolves a turn by advancing to the player who follows the one that\n      # submitted the most recent player-side turn (action or travel). Rest turns\n      # do not rotate the queue so a resting player keeps their place in the cycle.\n      last_action_row = d.get_first_row(\n        \"SELECT actor FROM play_narrations WHERE campaign_id = ? AND kind IN ('action', 'travel') ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1\",\n        campaign_id\n      )\n      last_actor = last_action_row ? last_action_row[0] : nil\n\n      next_actor = if last_actor && members.include?(last_actor)\n                     members[(members.index(last_actor) + 1) % members.length]\n                   else\n                     members[0]\n                   end\n\n      next_sequence = record_narration(d, campaign_id, 'resolution', 'dm', text)\n\n      new_turn_number = turn_number.to_i + 1\n\n      d.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaigns SET current_actor = ?, turn_number = ? WHERE id = ?',\n        [next_actor, new_turn_number, campaign_id]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'sequence' => next_sequence,\n        'kind' => 'resolution',\n        'actor' => 'dm',\n        'text' => text,\n        'next_actor' => next_actor,\n        'turn_number' => new_turn_number\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.nudge(campaign_id, actor, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    message = payload['message']\n    return [:invalid] unless message.is_a?(String) && !message.empty?\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign = d.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT owner, status, current_actor, nudge_count FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?',\n        campaign_id\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign\n\n      owner, status, current_actor, nudge_count = campaign\n      next [:forbidden] unless owner == actor[:username]\n      next [:conflict] unless status == 'active' && current_actor\n\n      new_nudge_count = nudge_count.to_i + 1\n      d.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaigns SET nudge_count = ? WHERE id = ?',\n        [new_nudge_count, campaign_id]\n      )\n\n      next_sequence = record_narration(d, campaign_id, 'nudge', owner, message)\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'actor' => owner,\n        'target' => current_actor,\n        'message' => message,\n        'nudge_count' => new_nudge_count\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.get_document(campaign_id, actor)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign = d.get_first_row('SELECT owner FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign\n\n      owner = campaign[0]\n      is_member = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT 1 FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?',\n        [campaign_id, actor[:username]]\n      )\n\n      if owner == actor[:username]\n        row = d.get_first_row(\n          'SELECT story, dm_notes FROM play_campaign_documents WHERE campaign_id = ?',\n          campaign_id\n        )\n        story = row ? row[0] : ''\n        dm_notes = row ? row[1] : ''\n        [:ok, { 'story' => story, 'dm_notes' => dm_notes }]\n      elsif is_member\n        row = d.get_first_row(\n          'SELECT story FROM play_campaign_documents WHERE campaign_id = ?',\n          campaign_id\n        )\n        story = row ? row[0] : ''\n        [:ok, { 'story' => story }]\n      else\n        [:forbidden]\n      end\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.update_document(campaign_id, actor, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    story = payload['story']\n    dm_notes = payload['dm_notes']\n    return [:invalid] unless story.is_a?(String) && dm_notes.is_a?(String)\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign = d.get_first_row('SELECT owner FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign\n\n      owner = campaign[0]\n      next [:forbidden] unless owner == actor[:username]\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO play_campaign_documents (campaign_id, story, dm_notes) VALUES (?, ?, ?)\n         ON CONFLICT(campaign_id) DO UPDATE SET story = excluded.story, dm_notes = excluded.dm_notes',\n        [campaign_id, story, dm_notes]\n      )\n\n      next_sequence = record_narration(d, campaign_id, 'document', owner, story)\n\n      [:ok, { 'story' => story, 'dm_notes' => dm_notes }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.create_scene(campaign_id, actor, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    data = validate_scene(payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless data\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign = d.get_first_row('SELECT owner FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign\n      next [:forbidden] unless campaign[0] == actor[:username]\n\n      existing = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT 1 FROM play_campaign_scenes WHERE campaign_id = ? AND encounter_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, data[:id]]\n      )\n      next [:conflict] if existing\n\n      # Only one encounter may be active at a time; starting a new one conflicts.\n      active = d.get_first_value(\n        \"SELECT 1 FROM play_encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND status = 'active'\",\n        campaign_id\n      )\n      next [:conflict] if active\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO play_encounters (campaign_id, encounter_id, name, status, combatants_json) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [campaign_id, data[:id], data[:name], 'active', '[]']\n      )\n\n      # Entering combat freezes the campaign actor and remembers who to restore later.\n      current_actor = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT current_actor FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?',\n        campaign_id\n      )\n\n      d.execute(\n        \"UPDATE play_campaigns SET phase = 'combat', pre_combat_actor = ?
